incident-bot: [ALERT] kv-cache prefetch error spike detected in prod cluster eu-west-1. paging surfacing, tail latency increase > 4x :rotating_light:
Jamie (oncall): seeing this on dashboards, retries spiking, customers getting 502s. tagging runtime and serving.
Priya (runtime): ack. Pulling up trace. looks like prefetch jobs for warmup are exploding and generating continuous batches with huge k-lengths.
Liam (serving): on it. hypothesis: prefetch window config merged yesterday (PR #5632) changed max_batch_window from 50ms -> 200ms, which could amplify KV cache prefetches.
Jamie (oncall): impact? which customers? any rate-limited tiers?
Priya (runtime): initial customer impact: 7 tenants with heavy long-convo chat; error % ~6% for them last 10m, overall 0.8%. Streaming throughput gated; tokens per second down ~30% for those flows.
Sophie (sre): escalated to incident severity 2. creating handoff for night oncall. Jamie, Priya please coordinate mitigation before handoff.
Liam (serving): quick mitigation options: revert config, roll back PR, or throttle prefetch concurrency. Reverting config is fastest.
Jamie (oncall): can we hotpatch runtime config without full deploy?
Priya (runtime): yes, config is in k/v store. I can roll max_batch_window back to 50ms and reduce prefetch_concurrency to 2. Doing dry-run now.
Priya (runtime): command: ```
# roll config
curl -X POST https://config-service.internal/v1/kv -d '{"path":"prefetch/max_batch_window","value":"50ms"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" 
```
Liam (serving): note: continuous-batcher has warmup cache that can still be overloaded; after config change we should trigger prefetch drain job to clear outstanding queued tasks.
Jamie (oncall): Priya, go for hotpatch. I'll notify customers slack & support.
Priya (runtime): applied change at 2443210102. reducing concurrency next.
deploy-bot: [CONFIG PATCH] prefetch/max_batch_window updated by priya at 2443210102.
Priya (runtime): also set prefetch_concurrency=2 at 2443210120.
Liam (serving): kicking off prefetch-drain job: ```
./tools/prefetch_ctl drain --cluster eu-west-1 --timeout 120
```
Liam (serving): drain started at 2443210130. monitoring.
Jamie (oncall): customers notified in #customer-impact with initial note. support triage started.
Sophie (sre): alert thresholds suppressed temporarily to reduce noise. will re-enable after stabilization.
Priya (runtime): metrics: paging rate down 60% in 3m post-change, queue depth halved, error % for affected tenants dropped from 6% -> 1.8%.
Liam (serving): tail latency for streaming requests improving, token cadence returning but still seeing intermittent partial flushes when large KV pages are evicted mid-stream.
Jamie (oncall): can we avoid evictions causing partial flushes?
Liam (serving): short term: bump cache eviction grace window to 10s to avoid mid-stream eviction churn. Doing that now.
Priya (runtime): applied eviction_grace=10s at 2443210195.
Sophie (sre): rolling change confirmed by deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: [CONFIG PATCH] eviction_grace updated by priya at 2443210196.
Priya (runtime): after grace bump: partial flush occurrences dropped to near zero in last 90s.
Jamie (oncall): great. still want a rollback of PR #5632 in staging and add a canary for prefetch changes.
Liam (serving): creating a follow-up: revert the change in staging, add stricter prefetch unit tests and a guard in CI to prevent >100ms batch windows for prefetch.
Sophie (sre): customer impact summary for ops: 7 tenants saw degraded streaming tokens and intermittent 5xxs for ~12m window, mitigated by config hotpatches and prefetch drain. No data loss.
Jamie (oncall): adding action items: 1) revert PR or patch to add runtime guards (owner: liam), 2) add canary and synthetic long-convo tests (owner: priya), 3) postmortem with timeline (owner: sophie).
Priya (runtime): creating rollback PR now: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/5791 (WIP).
Liam (serving): I'll pair with Priya on the canary and we should instrument batch window histogram per tenant for alerts.
Jamie (oncall): handing off to night oncall Sophie at 2443210300. Sophie, please continue monitoring and escalate to eng-leads if we see >2% global error.
Sophie (sre): ack, taking over. keeping watch on eu-west-1 and customer channels.
incident-bot: [Handoff] incident responded, oncall handoff from jamie -> sophie at 2443210300. severity remains SEV2.
Sophie (sre): quick notes for handoff: current mitigations in place: prefetch window reverted, concurrency lowered, eviction grace increased, prefetch-drain run. still tracking: batchifier slot growth for long conversations; follow-up required.
Jamie (oncall): thanks team. I'll draft a short customer post and add timeline to the incident doc.
Sophie (sre): assigning postmortem, will include root cause hypothesis: unguarded config change allowed prefetch to aggregate huge batches + aggressive eviction interplay causing streaming partial flushes.
Liam (serving): attaching logs snippet for later: ```
[2443210098] prefetch task queued size=128 tenant=acme corp key_prefix=convo_xxx
[2443210101] batcher flushed size=128 delay=210ms backend_kv_pages=34
[2443210115] eviction triggered tenant=acme corp pages=8 mid_stream=true
```
Priya (runtime): adding follow-ups in tracker: - CI guard - telemetry per-tenant batch sizes - rollout checklist for prefetch config changes.
Sophie (sre): closing thread for now; will reopen if regressions reappear. :white_check_mark:
